description:
FOUND s492 (Fable, 2026-09-20) by the modules-work battery (#1994, mw-20).  Probe: ~/pcl-agent-scratch/s492/probes/flock1.pl.  Every script with a lock file / a pid file / an append-to-shared-log uses it.  FIX: a runtime `p-flock` over the handle's fd (sb-posix has no flock binding -- check; `sb-alien` on libc `flock(int, int)` is the portable route on Linux AND macOS; LOCK_SH 1 / LOCK_EX 2 / LOCK_NB 4 / LOCK_UN 8 are the same on both); returns true/false with `$!` set (EWOULDBLOCK for LOCK_NB on a held lock -- probe with a forked child holding the lock); flush the handle's output buffer before locking/unlocking as perl does; a closed / never-opened handle = false + EBADF (rule 12: no silent success).  ALSO audit the SIBLINGS in one table (each probed `defined &CORE::name`-style under ./runpcl: exists / missing): fcntl ioctl sysopen sysseek syswrite sysread truncate link symlink readlink utime chown umask getppid getpgrp setpgrp getpriority wait times -- file each MISSING one in this task's DONE section or fix it if it is the same one-line shape.  The battery program mw-20 also exercises sysopen O_EXCL, sysseek, `$!{ENOENT}` (%! hash), S_IMODE/S_ISREG -- it must == perl after the fix; what else it hits is filed per cause.  BAR: `cl/` => full sweep + companion io/ op/ legs that flock (`grep -a -l flock`), `tools/ir-inventory.pl` (new export), guard rows with a forked contender, RANGE-free (no timing assertions).


=== DONE (s492c, 2026-09-21, Opus) ===
`p-flock` over the handle's fd.  sb-posix HAS the symbol and never defines the
function, so the route is the C entry point via `sb-alien:define-alien-routine`
-- flock(2) is the same call with the same operation bits (LOCK_SH 1 / LOCK_EX
2 / LOCK_NB 4 / LOCK_UN 8) on Linux and macOS, so lib/Fcntl.pm's constants
travel unchanged and nothing platform-specific is written down.

The handle's buffered output is flushed FIRST, as perl does; a closed or
never-opened handle is EBADF + FALSE through `%p-io-errno-fail`, never a
silent success (rule 12).  `flock => 2` in Config.pm's param table and `flock`
in %RUNTIME_NAMES; corpus-diff IDENTICAL over 111 files.

Probe flock1.pl identical to perl 5.40.3 including a FORKED CONTENDER that
must not get the lock; the only divergence is the warnings-gated "flock() on
closed filehandle" diagnostic (#221).  Guard: one row in Pl/t/fileio-02.t.

THE SIBLING TABLE the task asked for, taken statically over the runtime's
p-NAME definitions (scratch/s492c/logs/builtin-table.txt): of 52 file/process
builtins, 37 have one and 15 do not -- ioctl, setpriority, telldir, seekdir,
gethostbyname, gethostbyaddr, getservbyname, getservbyport, formline, chroot,
dbmopen, msgget, semget, shmget, syscall.  That is #2093's list, confirmed
independently; #2093 owns them.

subject: MISSING BUILTIN (everyday): `flock` does not exist -- `flock($fh, LOCK_EX)` dies "Undefined subroutine &main::flock called"; lib/Fcntl.pm exports the LOCK_* constants and the runtime's prototype table lists `flock` (`*$`), but there is no `p-flock`, and docs/not-supported.md does not mention it
